description: Read the current schematic page and return heuristic component groups plus direct non-ground wire islands. Set get_full_schematic_groups to concatenate page-local results from every schematic page. maybe_blocks and wires[].pins contain space-separated references; groups may omit singleton or ambiguous components. errors contains non-fatal diagnostics when the result is partial. declared_blocks and declared_modules list blocks the designer declared with the PCB Block, PCB Module, PCB Attach and PCB Role component properties; they are explicit and take precedence over maybe_blocks; declaration_errors reports problems with them only, each with a stable code; conflicts lists block attributes omitted because members disagree. Use get_schematic for values, pin names and the electrical netlist.

get_full_schematic_groups.description: Read and concatenate schematic groups from every page in the current schematic.

name: get_schematic_groups
title: Get EasyEDA Schematic Groups
